title: Pullman's conservatory across 18th Street, rebuilt from two 1890s pictures
items: The glasshouses at 1800 Calumet are now built from the 1894 Inland Architect plate and a c. 1897 photograph instead of a 1911 insurance map alone. Beman's conservatory now stands as a pointed Gothic glass house on a stone base, with an arched entrance, a transept and a ribbed glass dome about 13 m up. The long range behind it is now masonry with a row of high windows, ending in a domed glass colonnade. Both pictures now sit on the conservatory's card.
